bundle.text:
# @ttmouse/dsh-generative-ui bundle patch: inserts the client-only plugin row
# into the web profile roster. Applied as a profile bundle layer (the
# `dsh.bundle.patch` manifest field) over dsh-base; activate with
# `dsh plugin --profile web add link:<this-directory>` plus adding
# `@ttmouse/dsh-generative-ui` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile
# package.json.
#
# The node half (exports ".") only announces the artifact convention to
# agents via the system prompt; the `dsh.client` declaration in package.json
# makes the browser half (exports "./client", served at /plugins/<id>/client.js)
# load in the web GUI and render ```generative-ui fenced blocks inline.
- insert:
    - id: '@ttmouse/dsh-generative-ui'
      name: '@ttmouse/dsh-generative-ui'

readme.text: Let the AI output **interactive HTML components** (Generative UI) directly in the DSH chat flow. The agent writes a fenced code block in its reply: ````md ```generative-ui 0 ``` ````

The plugin extracts every artifact from that turn and renders it as a sandboxed
card below the message: an `<iframe sandbox="allow-scripts">` (no same-origin)
— the artifact is fully interactive, but can never touch the host page,
cookies, or local storage.

- **Pure client-side: no backend, no storage.** Artifacts live in the session
  message text — the session is the store; there is no second copy of state
  and nothing to sync.
- The host half does one thing: broadcast the fenced-block convention to every
  agent via `systemPrompt.section`.
- The browser half uses a `uiConversation.events` accumulator to extract
  artifacts from `assistant/message` events (the same turn-accumulator pattern
  as dsh-taskboard), projects them onto the turn location, and renders the
  cards through the `conversation.chat.turnTail` slot.
- Adaptive height: a bootstrap injected into each artifact reports its height
  to the parent via ResizeObserver + postMessage; cards are clamped between
  120–600px and scroll internally beyond that.

An artifact is a bare iframe document: no font, no spacing reset, no surface. Every artifact document therefore gets a design system inlined into `<head>` (`DESIGN_SYSTEM_CSS`), so constrained generation is enforced at runtime rather than merely requested in the prompt:

- **Separate regions with surfaces, not borders.** `--gui-surface-1/2/3` is a three-step surface ramp; `--gui-tint` / `--gui-tint-strong` are accent washes.
- **Three type sizes, no more.** `--gui-fs-title`(18) / `--gui-fs-body`(14) / `--gui-fs-caption`(12); hierarchy comes from weight and `--gui-fg-dim`, not from 1.08-ratio size steps.
- **Spacing and radius are tokens only.** `--gui-gap`(12) / `--gui-pad`(16), radius `--gui-radius`(12) / `--gui-radius-sm`(8); chips stay fully round.
- **Outer spacing is reset.** `html,body{margin:0!important;padding:0!important}` keeps artifacts flush with the message column; inner blocks own their spacing.
- **A typography baseline.** System font stack, 14px/1.7, an 11–17px size scale — no browser-default serif.
- **Utilities**: `.gui-stack` `.gui-section` `.gui-section--tint` `.gui-card` `.gui-tint` `.gui-chip` `.gui-chip--on` `.gui-label` `.gui-title` `.gui-desc` `.gui-note` `.gui-grid`.
- **Interaction and motion built in.** `button` ships with the primary style, `:active` scale, `:focus-visible` ring and 44px touch height; motion stays on `transform`/`opacity` under 200ms with `--gui-ease`, plus a `prefers-reduced-motion` fallback.
- **Audit
The same rules travel to the model as text in `GENERATIVE_UI_GUIDANCE`.

让 AI 在 DSH 对话流里直接输出**可交互的 HTML 组件**（Generative UI）。 agent 在回复正文里写一段 fenced code block： ````md ```generative-ui 0 ``` ```` 插件把这一轮回答里的所有工件提取出来，在该轮消息下方渲染成沙箱卡片： 内嵌 `

- **纯客户端，零后端，零存储。** 工件就活在会话消息文本里——会话在，工件就在；
  没有第二份状态，没有同步问题。
- 宿主半边只做一件事：通过 `systemPrompt.section` 把围栏约定广播给每个 agent。
- 浏览器半边用 `uiConversation.events` 事件累加器从 `assistant/message` 事件里
  提取工件（与 dsh-taskboard 的 turn 累加器同款模式），投影到 turn location，
  再由 `conversation.chat.turnTail` slot 渲染卡片。
- 高度自适应：注入每个工件的 bootstrap 用 ResizeObserver 向 parent
  postMessage 报告高度，卡片夹在 120–600px 之间，超出内部滚动。
工件是裸的 iframe 文档：没有字体、没有间距重置、没有底色。插件的每个工件文档都会在 `<head>` 注入一份设计系统（`DESIGN_SYSTEM_CSS`），把「有约束地生成」落到运行时，而不是只写在提示词里：

- **分层靠底色，不靠描边。** `--gui-surface-1/2/3` 是由浅到深的三层底面，`--gui-tint` / `--gui-tint-strong` 是强调色淡底；分区不再用 1px border。
- **字号只留三档。** `--gui-fs-title`(18) / `--gui-fs-body`(14) / `--gui-fs-caption`(12)，上下文层级靠字重与 `--gui-fg-dim`，不再堆 11/12.5/13.5 这类 1.08 比例的字号差。
- **间距与圆角只有令牌。** `--gui-gap`(12) / `--gui-pad`(16)，圆角 `--gui-radius`(12) / `--gui-radius-sm`(8)；chips 用全圆。
- **外边距强制归零。** `html,body{margin:0!important;padding:0!important}`，工件与对话正文左对齐，间距由内层区块承担。
- **自带排版基线。** 系统字体栈、14px/1.7、11–17px 字号档位，避免落到浏览器默认衬线字体。
- **工具类**：`.gui-stack` `.gui-section` `.gui-section--tint` `.gui-card` `.gui-tint` `.gui-chip` `.gui-chip--on` `.gui-label` `.gui-title` `.gui-desc` `.gui-note` `.gui-grid`。
- **交互态与动效内置。** `button` 自带主按钮样式、`:active` 缩放、`:focus-visible` 焦点环，触控设备最小 44px；动效只用 `transform`/`opacity`，≤200ms，`--gui-ease` 缓动，并带 `prefers-reduced-motion` 兜底。
- **审计**：`auditArtifactSource(source)` 返回违反项（`border` / `shadow` / `gradient` / `blur` / `body-spacing` / `comment` / `em-dash` / `buzzword` / `pure-color`），只提示不拦截。
同一套规则以文字形式写进 systemPrompt（`GENERATIVE_UI_GUIDANCE`），模型在生成时即可遵守。
